meta.name: The Pursuit: F1 ACADEMY
meta.description: Offering unparalleled behind-the-scenes access to the 2025 F1 ACADEMY season, follow a group of elite female drivers, including Doriane Pin, Maya Weug, Chloe Chambers and Alisha Palmowski, as they navigate the pressures of competition and the personal sacrifices required to break into one of the most demanding sports in the world.
